hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: folder_path
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
File path to the rawData folder
ex: s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/imaging_mesa_ecg/rawData/

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: visit_name
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
Name of the Visit
ex: V5, Visit1, etc.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
mkdir ./${folder_path} mkdir ./${folder_path}/rawData/ mkdir ./${folder_path}/rawData/${visit_name}/
ls ./${folder_path}/rawData/
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/development_imaging/execute_xml_to_csv.py ./
aws s3 cp --recursive s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${folder_path}/rawData/${visit_name}/ ./${folder_path}/rawData/${visit_name}/ --exclude "*" --include "*.xml"
chmod +x execute_xml_to_csv.py
python3 execute_xml_to_csv.py ./${folder_path}/rawData/ ${visit_name}
aws s3 cp --recursive ./${folder_path}/rawData/ s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${folder_path}/rawData/ --exclude "*" --include ".csv"
